packageRules.description: Ignore platform-managed monitoring/logging Argo CD app manifests (chart versions are bumped via the platform release process, not Renovate). Scoped to this repo only.

Ignore container image updates in values.yaml ONLY for the images consumed by the apps above (kube-prometheus-stack/grafana, loki, fluent-operator, promtail, loki-alert-group-controller). All other values.yaml images still get PRs.
